# Test vector review summary

> **Status: pending human review.** Every vector file in this directory carries
> `"review_status": "pending-human-review"`. Treat the expected values as
> provisional until a maintainer has checked this summary and flipped the status.
>
> This file is generated by `python3 scripts/vectors.py review`; do not edit it by hand.

## How the expected values were produced

* **contenthash** — inputs are written by hand; the expected hashes were
  computed with `shasum -a 256` and with `python3 -I` + `hashlib` (both agree),
  not with the Go code. The Go tests then check the implementation against them.
* **pathx** — expected results are written by hand from the rules, and checked by
  an independent Python implementation (`scripts/vectors.py`, stdlib
  `unicodedata`) as well as by the Go tests.
* Unicode data: the Go implementation uses `golang.org/x/text` (Unicode 17.0.0);
  the Python check ran with Python's `unicodedata` (Unicode 14.0.0). The vectors
  only use characters whose NFC and case-fold behavior is the same in both versions.

Re-run all checks:

```bash
python3 scripts/vectors.py verify
go test ./internal/contenthash ./internal/pathx
printf 'hello\n' | shasum -a 256   # 5891b5b5…6be03, see table below
```


## 1. contenthash

Rule: `sha256:` + 64 lowercase hex of SHA-256 over the exact bytes. No normalization of content.

| name | input | size | expected hash |
|---|---|---:|---|
| empty | utf8 (empty string) | 0 | `sha256:e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855` |
| hello | utf8 `hello` | 5 | `sha256:2cf24dba5fb0a30e26e83b2ac5b9e29e1b161e5c1fa7425e73043362938b9824` |
| hello-newline | utf8 `hello\u000a` | 6 | `sha256:5891b5b522d5df086d0ff0b110fbd9d21bb4fc7163af34d08286a2e846f6be03` |
| non-ascii | utf8 `内容寻址 Größe café ☕ 🚀` | 35 | `sha256:028fdc5ff5fe2daa2dbef823a0e7f8c3477ddcff3cd5bbce38ae2aad77faf9dd` |
| cafe-nfc | utf8 `café` | 5 | `sha256:850f7dc43910ff890f8879c0ed26fe697c93a067ad93a7d50f466a7028a9bf4e` |
| cafe-nfd-is-different-content | utf8 `cafe\u0301` | 6 | `sha256:81ef060bcd98adc7824eb5c1ada83c32491b16018e11e79f00ab9d09e04b015a` |
| bytes-00-ff | hex bytes 00..ff | 256 | `sha256:40aff2e9d2d8922e47afd4648e6967497158785fbd1da870e7110266bf944880` |
| prng-1mib | generator `sha256-counter` seed `mfgraph/contenthash/v1` length 1048576 | 1048576 | `sha256:433af2ef3c6bdf729952739e2ac9ddcd67d3c7e0d28ac7bee76d59d187f6a8bd` |

Parse rejects (must all fail): empty, missing sha256: prefix, uppercase prefix, uppercase hex digits, 63 hex digits, 65 hex digits, non-hex digit, leading space, trailing newline, space before colon, wrong algorithm spelling, unsupported algorithm.

## 2. pathx

Rule order: UTF-8 + non-empty → absolute / backslash / control (U+0000–U+001F, U+007F) → NFC → empty / `.` / `..` segments → segment ≤ 255 B and path ≤ 4096 B (NFC bytes). First failure wins.
